verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is a consumer graphics card. Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a capability of a service or platform with an access-control model, so the question is a category error for GPU hardware. Nothing in the evidence (DLSS, CUDA Toolkit, NVIDIA app, G-Assist) shows the product ships any credential-issuance system that would make the axis apply.
